answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply orders the work as 'Fix first: these break reservations' (items 1 to 5), then 'Fix next', 'Smaller issues' and a 'Suggested order'. Under 'What I inferred' it says it tested in Chromium only, 'didn't run VoiceOver or TalkBack' (so screen-reader points come from the markup), and that a pass on a real iPhone with VoiceOver and larger text is still needed.

mapping.title: Basket hold expires after 10 minutes with no warning or way back
mapping.reason: Same as D10: nothing says the hold lasts ten minutes, and once it lapses Continue only says 'Something went wrong. Try again.' without saying what happened or what to do. The review's point that retrying never succeeds is the same unhandled lapse.

mapping.title: Pick-up day and pick-up session are chosen separately and can disagree
mapping.reason: The day chosen on the tool page and the session chosen in the basket are never checked against each other. The review's drill listed for 'Saturday 17 October' with the 'Wednesday 21 October' session, so 'the desk can't tell which one is right', is D15's own example and harm.

mapping.title: Calendar accepts closed days; refused only on the confirm page with no link back
mapping.reason: Every day can be chosen including closed ones, and the refusal ('The library is closed on Friday 16 October...') only comes on the confirm page, with no link back to where the day is changed. That is D06.

mapping.title: Days and sessions before a tool is available are accepted
mapping.reason: The calendar allows 'days before the tool is back' and the basket accepted the 10 Oct session for a pressure washer available from 17 Oct. Offering only sessions on or after each tool's 'available from' date fixes D14.

mapping.title: Tapping Confirm twice books the tool twice
mapping.reason: The Confirm button stays enabled with no visible busy state for 1.5 s, and a second tap gave FT-4471 and FT-4472 for the same drill. That is D12.

mapping.title: Basket not emptied after a confirmed booking
mapping.reason: After the booking the header still shows 'Basket (1)' on the confirmation (done) page. That is D18.

mapping.title: Truncated tool names make the two drills look the same on a phone
mapping.reason: Names are cut to one line, so both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co...' at 375 px and the battery difference is hidden. That is D03.

mapping.title: A search with no results silently keeps the old list
mapping.reason: Searching 'hammer' leaves all ten tools on the page and announces nothing, so members cannot tell that nothing matched. That is D02.

mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge fails text contrast
mapping.reason: #2f7d4a on #1d2622, about 3.07:1 for 16 px bold text in the dark theme, below 4.5:1. That is D04.

mapping.title: Faint calendar day borders and selected-day fill in dark mode
mapping.reason: The review itself says the selected day is still shown by its 2 px border, and it gives no reading showing that this marker or the day numbers are hard to see. Day buttons labelled by their numbers do not need strong borders to be found, so this is a styling note with no harm shown.

mapping.title: Loan-length dropdown shadow does not show in dark mode
mapping.reason: A shadow is decoration. The review does not say the open list blends into the page or that any option is hard to read, so this is a matter of styling.

mapping.title: On phones the search and filters sit below all ten tools behind an icon-only button
mapping.reason: Below 480 px the order rules put the search form under the results, and the date filter is behind an icon-only button, so members do not find the date filter. That is D01. The review puts the keyboard/visual order mismatch on desktop, while the ground truth puts it at phone width, but it comes from the same order rules, and dropping them fixes D01.

mapping.title: Basket pick-up sessions shown in reverse order
mapping.reason: row-reverse with wrap-reverse shows Wed 28 Oct first and Sat 10 Oct last on a phone, while the keyboard and screen readers go in date order. That is D11.

mapping.title: Confirm page rejects ordinary membership-number and phone formats
mapping.reason: 'ft-01234', 'FT 01234', '+44 7700 900123' and '07700 900 123' are all rejected, with no normalising. That is D17.

mapping.title: Loan-length dropdown traps the keyboard
mapping.reason: While the list is open, Tab cycles through the options instead of leaving it, and Escape does not close it. That is the keyboard trap in D09.

mapping.title: Loan-length dropdown does not close when tapping outside
mapping.reason: On a phone, the members' main device, the open list stays until an option is chosen. A member who opened it by mistake, or only to look, has to pick a loan length to close it and may change it without meaning to. D09 covers only the keyboard.

mapping.title: Fixed 'Reserve this tool' bar covers the footer and desk phone number
mapping.reason: Nothing keeps the page clear of the fixed bar, so on a phone the footer with the desk phone number sits under it even at the bottom of the page. D08 names exactly this phone symptom. The review does not mention covered focused day buttons, so it reports the narrower part of the same defect.

mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' vanishes after 1.2 s with no next step nearby
mapping.reason: This is about the feedback after the press: a 1.2 s message, with the header 'Basket (1)' link as the only lasting sign and the only way on. It does not claim members believe the tool is reserved, so under the D07/D26 rule it goes to D07.

mapping.title: Tool grid scrolls sideways at 320 px
mapping.reason: minmax(330px, 1fr) gives 346 px of content in a 320 px screen, so the page scrolls sideways (WCAG 1.4.10). That is D05.

mapping.title: Confirm page 'Change' link drops the chosen session
mapping.reason: The 'Change' link returns to the basket with no session ticked. That is D13.

mapping.title: Returning to the confirm page clears the details already typed
mapping.reason: Coming back to the confirm page empties the details the member had typed, so they must be entered again on a phone. That is D22.

mapping.title: Three-tools-per-member limit not enforced in the basket
mapping.reason: The basket does not enforce the stated three-tool rule. That is D21.

mapping.title: Confirmation page reads the tool name twice to screen readers
mapping.reason: The visually hidden #c-tool copy makes screen readers read the reserved tool's name twice on the done (confirmation) page. That is D24.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up session' error link points at a container that cannot take focus
mapping.reason: Following the error link does not put focus on the session radio buttons, so a member using VoiceOver or TalkBack may hear nothing happen and has to hunt for the choices. This is not in the ground truth: D23 is about the date being asked for twice, not about where this link goes.

mapping.title: No 'Skip to content' link on any page
mapping.reason: The review shows no long repeated block that members must get past (the header it mentions holds the basket link), and it does not say headings or landmarks are missing. On these short, phone-first pages, no harm is shown, so this is a checklist remark.
